raw:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "send"
      role subject "Teodora"
      role object "the offer"
      role time ?t1
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "call"
      role subject "the Bitdefender people"
      role time ?t2
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  order ?t1 before ?t2
